verdict.rationale: Checkout.com documents low-code onboarding paths: a Flow get-started guide, a Hosted Payment Page marketed as a "fully branded checkout page in less than a day," an official Node.js SDK, and a public test account with test cards and per-scenario testing docs. That supports a fast first integration, but the evidence never shows copy-paste code samples across multiple languages. The under-a-day claim covers only the hosted page and comes from marketing copy. missing for 10: evidence of copy-paste code examples in multiple languages, SDKs beyond Node.js, hands-on or independent corroboration of a sub-one-day docs-only integration.
